mapper.insert: INSERT INTO onsite_session_state_v1 (session_key, parent_session_key, current_round, max_rounds, answered_signals_json) VALUES (#{sessionKey}, #{parentSessionKey}, #{currentRound}, #{maxRounds}, CAST(#{answeredSignalsJson} AS JSON))
